svg.title: Terminal rotation during butadiene cyclization
svg.desc: Each row is a path image and each column is one evaluated iteration. Blue is disrotatory, orange conrotatory, and gray unresolved. The dark mark follows the highest-energy interior image. No values are drawn beyond the last checkpoint.
